data.body:
REBASED ONTO THE CLICK FIX AND RE-PUSHED — patch set 3 on both changes.

WHY: the pip dependency block cleared on main as commit 31844d5f9fb ("1dfd: fix PYSEC-2026-2132 via
click override" — override-dependencies click>=8.3.3 in pyproject, click resolving to 8.4.2 in the
lock). But patch set 2 of both changes was based on a PRE-FIX main, and Gerrit CI runs the patch set
AS PUSHED — Rebase-If-Necessary only applies at SUBMIT time. So a plain recheck would have re-run
pip-audit against the OLD lock content and produced another Verified -1 for a cause already fixed.
Rebasing was required, not optional.

WHAT WAS DONE, and what was verified rather than assumed:
 * rebased agent-bd9e onto origin/main at 31844d5f9fb: clean, no conflicts, still exactly 2 commits;
 * BOTH Change-Ids preserved (I84c8802406f5781e1858f40ce6142b30daf87d55 on the single-source change,
   I68a69ce9a33cd84fd799758762fdcc07bed2baa1 on the guard), so these are new patch sets on the same
   two changes rather than duplicate changes;
 * re-ran scripts/gen_env_registry.py: NO drift. Worth stating explicitly, because the env-var
   registry records LINE NUMBERS and was the real cause of this change's only genuine earlier CI
   failure — the rebase did not shift any env-var read;
 * re-ran the two tests that matter most for this change on the rebased tree: the boundary guard
   suite and the module-attribute consumer (test_outbound_differ_session_log_exclusion.py, which
   reads outbound_fields._LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE as a module attribute and is the reason the absolute
   import form is mandatory). 28 passed.
 * pushed as patch set 3; Gerrit accepted both as updates to 1240 and 1241.

WHAT TO EXPECT: pip-audit should now pass, because the tree under test finally contains the override.
The LLM-Review +1 already earned on the guard change may be copied forward under the trivial-rebase
copy condition; if it is not, that is a copy-condition detail and not a new objection.

REMAINING: land both once Verified lands, then close this ticket. It is the LAST open P1 child of
epic 3e73-72b5-cff2-40f0 — cedc, 79d5 and 2944 are all closed.
